newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines retrieve artifacts in sunken ship.
newsitem.headline: Philippines retrieve artifacts in sunken ship.

text.p: Filipino and French divers have retrieved precious artifacts dating from the 14th and 15th centuries from a ship that sank in the southwestern Philippines, an official said on Friday.

The divers retrieved 4,992 artifacts from the ship which sunk off Pandanan island in Palawan, 810 kms (506 miles) south of Manila, Wilfredo Ronquillo, chief of the archaeology division of the Philippine National Museum told a news conference.
Ronquillo said the artifacts include Vietnamese, Chinese and Thai ceramic jars.

The ship, whose name has not been determined, was believed to have sunk between 1400 to 1444 since the divers also found 27 pieces of Chinese coins minted during the Yong Le dynasty period, Ronquillo said.
